categories.main_business_segments: Lelon Electronics primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of aluminum electrolytic capacitors and aluminum foil. The company offers a comprehensive product lineup including leaded, surface-mount, polymer solid, and hybrid capacitors, serving various applications such as automotive electronics, telecommunications, industrial automation, medical devices, green energy, and cloud computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes including cutting, winding, impregnation, assembly, casing, charging and sorting, processing, and packaging. It emphasizes vertical integration with key raw materials like formed aluminum foil, etched foil, electrolyte paper, and electrolyte chemicals. R&D focuses on high-temperature, long-life, low-impedance capacitors and new materials and production equipment co-developed with research institutes and suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lelon's customers include international major manufacturers in automotive electronics, telecommunications, industrial automation, medical electronics, green energy, and cloud computing sectors. The company supplies both consumer electronics and high-reliability applications such as telecom infrastructure and automotive safety electronics, targeting global OEMs and system integrators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, China (Huizhou and Suzhou), and Thailand (under construction). Sales are primarily export-oriented, covering Asia, Americas, and Europe, with a strong presence in Taiwan and China. The company is expanding its international footprint through strategic investments and production capacity expansion in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lelon operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing aluminum electrolytic capacitors from raw materials like aluminum foil and chemicals. It maintains vertical integration in raw material sourcing and capacitor production, supplying downstream electronic product designers and assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding capacity for high-end products such as stacked polymer capacitors and solid-liquid hybrid capacitors. R&D focuses on developing high-temperature, high-voltage, long-life capacitors tailored for automotive and industrial applications. Strategic initiatives include deepening partnerships with customers, enhancing production automation, and introducing strategic investors to strengthen competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Lelon's revenue is generated primarily through product sales of aluminum electrolytic capacitors and aluminum foil. The company sells to global customers on a contract manufacturing and direct sales basis, with no indication of subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lelon is Taiwan's largest aluminum electrolytic capacitor manufacturer and ranks among the top ten globally. It competes with mainly Japanese manufacturers in the high-end capacitor market but distinguishes itself as a leading non-Japanese supplier with extensive certifications and shipment records to major international customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lelon achieved consolidated revenue exceeding NT$10.4 billion, a 16.5% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company rising by 25.3% to NT$1.15 billion. The company shows steady growth supported by expanding production capacity and increasing demand in automotive and industrial electronics sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lelon emphasizes high-quality, high-stability aluminum electrolytic capacitors with a broad and vertically integrated product portfolio. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines tailored for niche high-margin markets, global customer service networks, and compliance with international environmental and safety standards. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-performance capacitors for demanding applications such as automotive electronics and telecommunications.
